audit.why: rows from the crown to the chin: the flicker check covers the head only (real 7-7.5-head proportions put the shoulders inside a fixed 22-row window); head_rows_dir gives it per facing, because a 3/4 or profile chin sits higher than the max
audit.fidget_why: idle frames with a deliberate glance (5-6) or blink (7): the head changes on purpose there, so those frame pairs are not flicker
